_comment: Generalization fixture (different domain). Read ONLY by the Scorer. Structurally different from Marcy: fewer bundles, different apps, its own conditional-branch and time-separated workflows and anti-bundles.

bundles.intent: Resume screening intake: when a new applicant appears, open the resume and score it against a checklist, then if it meets the bar advance to the phone-screen stage, otherwise send a templated rejection (one workflow with a conditional branch).
Schedule a phone screen by sending a calendar invite to candidates who advanced.
Log structured interview feedback into the ATS after interviews.
Build a candidate shortlist in the morning and send it to the hiring manager in the afternoon (trigger and execution separated in time, linked by the shortlist artifact).
Source candidates and send a standard outreach message.

anti_bundles.intent: Decide whether to extend an offer and at what level and compensation — a discretionary judgment based on scorecards and leveling.
Respond to a candidate upset about the process with a personalized, relationship-sensitive message.
